_comment: Canonical entity-IRI overrides for prefixes whose SSSOM sets disagree on the IRI stem (ADR-0029). Keyed by UPPERCASE CURIE prefix (EntityReference upper-cases before lookup, so this also covers lower-case declarations like 'mesh'). 'canonical' wins over the set's own curie_map AND the Bioregistry fallback, so an entity always expands to one IRI regardless of how a set spelled it. 'aliases' are alternate stems rewritten to 'canonical' when a source hands us a full IRI (longest alias wins, which keeps overlapping stems like OMIM 'MIM:' vs OMIMPS 'MIM:PS' disjoint). Candidates come from PrefixDivergenceDetector; this list is CURATED — it holds only prefixes verified to be true aliases of one entity space with an identity-IRI canonical. Deliberately excluded: prefix COLLISIONS where one prefix names two different things (GEO = Geographical Entity Ontology vs NCBI GEO datasets), curie_map corruption (AFO, *_2 duplicate prefixes, double-expanded OBO PURLs, unknown_prefix placeholders), and resolver-URL/structure/publication identifiers out of the disease-mapping domain.
